AITA for wanting my boyfriend to help me prepare for a Christmas party rather than sleepover at his buddy’s?
My (22) boyfriend and I (22) have a games night with our friends on the weekends every once in a while, and I planned a Christmas dinner/games night with them all for this Sunday.  It’ll be at his dads place, which is new and fairly roomy. His dad is never there, so we take care of the house (2 story, basement, 3 bathroom, 4 bedroom) just us two. 

I planned to cook an entire meal for everyone (11 people including us) , being a couple of beef roasts, mashed potatoes, veggies, desserts..etc. We’ve yet to get groceries/decorations because we’ve both had a busy work week. I talked with him loosely about going out tonight to get groceries after he’s done helping a buddy with some body work on his car. Early today we talked about seeing eachother tonight still. 

He was seeing a different buddy (a long time friend, one who will be at the party on Sunday) tomorrow just to hangout for half the day, but not long ago today he asked if it was alright if he could sleepover at his place tonight.  It stressed me out (I have a serious anxiety disorder) because I was expecting one thing and he kind of surprised me by changing the plans around that I had set in my head. I told him we had a lot to do still to prepare for Sunday, and he said okay and that he had canceled the plans, but I knew I upset him by the way the tone of his messages changed. 
I got even more stressed and upset because I knew I upset him and I felt like an asshole for seemingly “making” him do this all with me.

**Minutes: year-end party planning call (songnyeonhoe, Sunday at Min-jae's father's flat, Bundang)**
Friday, 19:40. Group voice call.

Present: Yoon Da-eun, Park Min-jae, Choi Hyun-woo, Lee Soo-ah. Minutes taken by me, Musonius, at Da-eun's request.

**1. Friday evening plans**

Da-eun had expected to shop with Min-jae tonight. Min-jae had asked earlier today to stay over at Hyun-woo's instead, then cancelled when she objected. Da-eun said the change of plan unsettled her because she had already fixed the evening in her head. She does not want Min-jae to give up his night resentfully. Min-jae said he cancelled because it seemed he had no choice, not because he agreed.

Hyun-woo said the sleepover can happen any weekend.

I noted that the shopping list for eleven people is long, but it is one trip of about two hours. Hyun-woo lives ten minutes from the E-Mart. Min-jae could shop with Da-eun from 20:30, drop the bags at his father's flat, and reach Hyun-woo's before midnight. Neither of them would lose what they actually needed from tonight. Da-eun would still have help with the hard part, and Min-jae would still have his night.

Min-jae agreed. Da-eun agreed, on condition the decision stays fixed and does not move again tonight.

**2. Cooking and decorations**

Soo-ah offered to make the side dishes and arrive early on Sunday. Da-eun keeps the roasts. Decorations to be bought tonight with the groceries.

**3. Saturday**

This item is still open. Da-eun would like Min-jae back by 15:00 Saturday to prepare. Min-jae and Hyun-woo had planned on the whole day. I said I could not see that Saturday afternoon was needed if tonight's shopping is done, but Da-eun disagreed. They will talk about it tomorrow morning.

**Actions**
- Da-eun: send the list to the group by 20:15.
- Min-jae: collect Da-eun at 20:30.
- Soo-ah: side dishes, arriving Sunday 14:00.

Call ended 20:02.

decision_relevant_adaptations: The truncated Christmas-party source becomes a Korean year-end planning call. Travel/shop times and offers of cooking help are invented. They enable a Friday compromise, not proof the original parties had this exact option. Saturday remains disputed; both source partners are adults.

This is honest, autonomy-respecting mediation, not a vice.
